mapper.sql: g.group_id, g.name, g.owner_id, g.need_consent, g.created_at, o.display_name AS owner_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_member x WHERE x.group_id = g.group_id AND x.status = 'ACCEPTED') AS accepted_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_member x WHERE x.group_id = g.group_id AND x.status = 'PENDING') AS pending_count
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_group (name, owner_id, need_consent) VALUES (#{name}, #{ownerId}, #{needConsent})
mapper.select: SELECT , m.status AS my_status FROM user_group g JOIN sys_user o ON o.user_id = g.owner_id LEFT JOIN group_member m ON m.group_id = g.group_id AND m.user_id = #{userId} WHERE g.owner_id = #{userId} OR m.user_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY g.created_at DESC, g.group_id DESC
SELECT m.*, u.username, u.display_name FROM group_member m JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = m.user_id WHERE m.group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY m.invited_at, m.user_id
SELECT user_id FROM group_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND status = 'ACCEPTED' ORDER BY user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_member (group_id, user_id, status, responded_at) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{userId}, #{status}, IF(#{status} = 'ACCEPTED', NOW(), NULL)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status), invited_at = NOW(), responded_at = VALUES(responded_at)
mapper.update: UPDATE group_member SET status = #{status}, responded_at = NOW() WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM group_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND user_id = #{userId}
